provenance.source: NECB 2025 Subsection 8.4.4 'Energy Use Intensity' via the building-codes MCP (necb:2025) — the NEW 2025 compliance path inserted at 8.4.4 (the 2020 reference-building articles renumbered to 8.4.5). BET = sum(A_i x EUI_i) + PL (8.4.4.1.(2)); applicable only where >= 90% of gross interior floor area maps to the listed archetypes (8.4.4.1.(1)) and HDD < 9000 (Table note (1)); unlisted space functions distribute proportionally (8.4.4.1.(4)); PL = process loads in excess of the Table 8.4.4.2 receptacle defaults; exterior lighting per 8.4.4.1.(5).
